criteria.acceptance: A written safety policy governs every workstation change.
Only allow-listed commands run, rebuilt from validated plan fields and never passed to a shell.
Dry run by default; every applied action needs an explicit yes; stale or foreign-policy plans are refused.
The run stops at the first failure and writes a local log of every selected action.
Audit, evaluation, plan and comparison stay read-only; only Update-Workstation.ps1 loads the executor.
An operator applies a real low-risk action on PC #1 through Run-Update.cmd.
criteria.manual: Run Run-Update.cmd on a fresh PC #1 plan with -Action <low-risk action> -Apply and record the log result in #183.
